top_story: Iran’s 15 November drone strike on the US base in Bahrain has widened by 17 November into a broader coercive posture, with renewed pressure around Hormuz, a US hit on Qeshm, and an explicit Iranian threat to treat civilian infrastructure near US or Israeli bases as dual-use targets. In Israel-Palestine, the exposure of the Israeli military’s use of millions of images on Amazon’s facial recognition platform underscores that the Gaza war’s logic extends beyond bombardment into mass surveillance and tighter control over Palestinian movement and daily life. The regional picture is one of converging military and technological pressure on civilians, with shipping routes, urban infrastructure, and personal autonomy increasingly drawn into the conflict space.
